name: Cheech & Chong - 6 Pack x 0.5g Cryo Infused Pre-Rolls - Pink Mustache
description:
Six joints, extra kick. The Cheech & Chong Pink Mustache 6-pack gives you six half-gram pre-rolls — 3 grams total — each packed with quality flower and cryo-infused with distillate for a bolder, more potent smoke. Perfectly portioned for shorter sessions, sharing, or keeping a few on hand.

Pink Mustache brings a sweet, playful profile: bright berry and candy-fruit notes up front, rounded out by a smooth, creamy finish. It's a fun, flavor-forward smoke made for easy sessions with an extra step up in strength.

Why you'll love it:

6 × 0.5G cryo-infused pre-rolls — 3 grams total, quality flower infused with distillate for extra potency
Perfectly portioned — right-sized for a quick session or passing around
Cryo-infusion process — locks in flavor and delivers a smooth, even burn
Signature Pink Mustache flavor — sweet berry and candy fruit with a creamy finish
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one
Big flavor, dependable potency, and effortless convenience in every pack. Cheech & Chong Pink Mustache is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
